answer: To register an agent vertex, the payer must irrevocably burn 50 tokens on-chain, proven by a Merkle receipt. This is an irreversible loss, not a lockup. Generating N Sybils scales linearly at 50N tokens because each key pays independently; discarding identities yields no refund. Whether managing a reef or cedar sensor market, Sybil expansion incurs pure, unrecoverable linear cost.
